item.title: consolidating ggplot guide_legend specification
item.description: I have a plot with color, shape, alpha, and size determined by a factor. Right now, in guides(), I have a guide\_legend(position='inside') for each of the features (color, size, etc). Is there a way to say I want the same guide\_legend() for a list of features?
